translationRepairs: During Taihe he received the rank Grand Mentor of the Golden Purple Glow.
During Taihe he received the rank Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold and Purple.
金紫光祿大夫 is a prestige rank, not a mentor post.
Early in Zhenyou Crown Prince Zhuangxian Shouzhong died. The court made his grandson Keng imperial great-grandson; he too died soon after.
Early in Zhenyou, Crown Prince Zhuangxian Shouzhong died. The court made his grandson Keng imperial grandson and heir; he too died soon after.
Punctuation separates the era from the title. 皇太孫 means imperial grandson-heir, not great-grandson.
Zhao Bingwen, minister of rites, Yang Yunyi, director of court music, and others said Shaanxi folk were still spent and could not bear corvée.
Zhao Bingwen, minister of rites, Yang Yunyi, chief minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others said Shaanxi folk were still spent and could not bear corvée.
太常卿 heads the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
Li Xi, grand minister of agriculture and defender of Ruzhou, became director of court music and acting participation councillor.
Li Xi, grand minister of agriculture and defender of Ruzhou, became chief minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and acting participation councillor.
太常卿 heads the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

On guimao Privy Council vice commissioner Wanyan Saibu became grand councillor; acting participation councillor Shizhuan Weixin became right vice director of the Masters of Writing; court music director Li Xi became Hanlin academician-in-chief while still acting as participation councillor.

On guimao Privy Council vice commissioner Wanyan Saibu became grand councillor; acting participation councillor Shizhan Weixin became right vice director of the Masters of Writing; chief minister of Imperial Sacrifices Li Xi became Hanlin academician-in-chief while still acting as participation councillor.
太常卿 heads the Court of Imperial Sacrifices. 石盞 is romanized Shizhan.
Chisan Hexi was named acting vice privy councilor.
Chizhan Hexi was named acting vice privy councilor.
On xinhai chief councillor Gao Rulü died.
On xinhai chief councillor Gao Ruli died.
高汝礪 is romanized Gao Ruli.
Sixth month, jiaxu: the chief ministers asked to kick the ball; the emperor, still in heart-mourning, refused. On xinmao Consort Tushi was made empress.
Sixth month, jiaxu: the chief ministers asked to kick the ball; the emperor, still in heart-mourning, refused. On xinmao Consort Tudan was made empress.
Privy Council vice commissioner Yila Pu’a marched to Guang Prefecture and posted notices on the Song border telling troops and people to raid south no more.
Privy Council assistant commissioner Yila Pu’a marched to Guang Prefecture and posted notices on the Song border telling troops and people to raid south no more.
樞密判官 is an assistant commissioner, not vice commissioner.
Ninth month: Privy Council vice commissioner Yila Pu’a recovered a thousand horses from Ze, Lu, and Huo.
Ninth month: Privy Council assistant commissioner Yila Pu’a recovered a thousand horses from Ze, Lu, and Huo.
樞密判官 is an assistant commissioner, not vice commissioner.
On jiayin the emperor kept Xuandzong’s lesser mourning and burned food offerings at Deling.
On jiayin the court observed Xuanzong’s lesser mourning and burned food offerings at Deling.

On guihai Minister of Rites Aodun Liangbi, Court of Judicial Review Director Puman Qinfu, and Attending Censor Wugulun Hongyi were dispatched as envoys to report the completed Xia treaty; the state letter addressed Jin as elder brother.

On guihai Minister of Rites Aodun Liangbi, Court of Judicial Review Director Peiman Qinfu, and Attending Censor Wugusun Hongyi were dispatched as envoys to report the completed Xia treaty; the state letter addressed Jin as elder brother.
烏古孫 is romanized Wugusun. 裴滿 is romanized Peiman.
An edict ordered the relevant offices to establish a Loyal-and-Filial Reward shrine for thirteen men who died for principle.
An edict ordered the relevant offices to establish a Shrine for Commending Loyalty for thirteen men who died for principle.
褒忠廟 commends loyalty; filial piety is not mentioned.
Lady of Xing State Che Jing took the imperial road past the temple; her driver rode horseback and two maids sat in the carriage without dismounting — all were ordered imprisoned and beaten.

The carriage of the Lady of Cheng State took the imperial road past the temple; her driver rode horseback and two maids sat in the carriage without dismounting — all were ordered imprisoned and beaten.
車 is her carriage, not a personal name; 郕 is Cheng.
In the eighth month Yelü Pu'a recovered Quwo and Jin'an.
In the eighth month Yila Pu’a recovered Quwo and Jin'an.
Keep 移剌蒲阿 consistent with earlier units.
The Shaanxi branch secretariat and chief commandants Wanyan Eke of Shaanxi and Heshilie Yawuta of Lingbao were called to Bian for a war council.
The Shaanxi branch secretariat and chief commandants Wanyan Eke of Shanzhou and Heshilie Yawuta of Lingbao were called to Bian for a war council.
陝州 is Shanzhou, not Shaanxi.
Wanyan Lüxin, palace attendant of the second rank, and others were dispatched to mourn in Xia.
Wanyan Lüxin, Grand Master for Palace Service, and others were dispatched to mourn in Xia.
中奉大夫 is a prestige rank title.
Great Yuan forces captured Deshun; Military Commissioner Ai Shen and Acting Prefect Ma Jianlong were killed.
Great Yuan forces captured Deshun; Military Commissioner Ai Shen and Acting Prefectural Judge Ma Jianlong were killed.
攝府判 is acting prefectural judge.
The Shaanxi branch secretariat offered three plans: take the field in person; move the court to Shaanzhou; or abandon Qin and hold Tong Pass.
The Shaanxi branch secretariat offered three plans: take the field in person; move the court to Shanzhou; or abandon Qin and hold Tong Pass.
Lu Ya and the other policy-essay and exegesis jinshi graduates received their degrees.
Lu Ya and the other rhapsody and classical-exegesis jinshi graduates received their degrees.
詞賦經義 are the rhapsody and exegesis tracks.

On renchen Urgun Buji, censor-in-chief, and libationer Peiman Ahu dai were also named acting ministers of revenue to enroll militia, drive the wealthy into walled towns, and supervise autumn taxes so people knew where to flee.

On renchen Wugusun Buji, vice censor-in-chief, and libationer Peiman Ahudai were concurrently named chief ministers of agriculture to enroll militia, drive the wealthy into walled towns, and supervise autumn taxes so people knew where to flee.
烏古孫 is Wugusun; 中丞 is vice censor-in-chief. Name is one word; 司農卿 heads agriculture.
On jisi, the longevity festival, Associate Director Shi Gongyi offered the Da Ding Legacy Admonitions and Attendant Lü Zao offered Essentials of the Documents.
On jisi, the longevity festival, Associate Director Shi Gongyi offered the Dading Legacy Admonitions and Attendant Lü Zao offered Essentials of the Documents.
大定 is the Dading era.
Li Quan came back from court, reoccupied Chuzhou, and beat the government force under Wanyan Eke and Marshal Qingshannu at Guishan after they tried to hold Xuyi.
Li Quan came back from the capital and reoccupied Chuzhou. The court sent Chief Commandant Wanyan Eke and Marshal Qingshannu to hold Xuyi; they fought Li Quan at Guishan and were defeated.
The Jin commanders were the ones defeated; restore the sequence.
In the tenth winter month, on xinyou, Right Remonstrance censor Li Dajie and Right Secretariat remonstrator Chen Gui charged Sahelian of the Imperial Clan Office with graft; the court did not answer.

In the tenth winter month, on xinyou, Right Reminder Li Dajie and Right Remonstrator Chen Gui charged Sahelian, associate administrator of the Office of Imperial Kin, with graft; the court did not answer.
右拾遺/右司諫/同判睦親府事 titles corrected.
On guichou an edict told offices to place a statue of Lintao commander Tuoman Hutumen in the Reward-Loyalty Temple.
On guichou an edict told offices to place a statue of Lintao commander Tuoman Hutumen in the Shrine for Commending Loyalty.
Keep 褒忠廟 consistent with the earlier unit.
On jiazi Participation Councillor Bai Sa became Right Vice Director of State; Court of Imperial Sacrifices director Yanshan Shilu was acting Participation Councillor.
On jiazi Participation Councillor Bai Sa became Right Vice Director of State; Court of Imperial Sacrifices director Yanzhan Shilu was acting Participation Councillor.

In the ninth month Tao, He, Lan, and Hui commissioner Yanshan Xiamo offered two western horses; an edict said, "Your fighting skill is superb; this horse belongs in battle — how could I as rider use up its power?

In the ninth month Tao, He, Lan, and Hui commissioner Yanzhan Xiamo offered two western horses; an edict said, "Your fighting skill is superb; this horse belongs in battle — how could I as rider use up its power?
The Guide traveling Privy Council was expanded with millions in corvée planned; an edict sent acting Privy Council judge Bai Hua to cite farmers' hardship and cut labor by two-thirds.

The Guide traveling Privy Council was expanded with millions in corvée planned; an edict sent acting Privy Council assistant commissioner Bai Hua to cite farmers' hardship and cut labor by two-thirds.
樞密院判官 is an assistant commissioner.
In the sixth year, spring, second month, on bingchen, Privy Council judge Yila Pu'a was acting vice director of the Privy Council.
In the sixth year, spring, second month, on bingchen, Privy Council assistant commissioner Yila Pu'a became acting vice commissioner of the Privy Council.
樞密院判官 and 樞密副使 titles corrected.
As Chancellor Wanyan Saibu would not take up Department affairs in Guanzhong, Participation Councillor Wanyan Heda was recalled.
Chancellor Wanyan Saibu was sent to run the branch Department of State Affairs in Guanzhong, and Grand Councillor Wanyan Heda was recalled to court.
以…行尚書省事 means he was posted to it; 平章政事 is grand councillor.
In the third month, on yihai, Loyal-and-Filial chief Chen Heshang won merit and was made General Who Settles the Distance, Pingliang prefectural judge, with hereditary meng'an.
In the third month, on yihai, Loyal-and-Filial chief Chen Heshang won merit and was made General Who Settles the Distance, Pingliang prefectural judge, with hereditary mouke.
世襲謀克 is a mouke, not meng’an.

In summer, the fifth month, Long Defense Commissioner Shimao Dong'er sent a yellow parrot; an edict said, "Tribute of rare birds and beasts from afar violates their nature and burdens the people — do not present them again."

In summer, the fifth month, Longzhou Defense Commissioner Shimo Dong'er sent a yellow parrot; an edict said, "Tribute of rare birds and beasts from afar violates their nature and burdens the people — do not present them again."
隴州 is Longzhou; 石抹 is Shimo.
On gengchen Wanyan Maqin, intendant of Kaifeng prefecture, was dispatched to Great Yuan with condolences.
On gengchen Wanyan Majinchu, intendant of Kaifeng prefecture, was dispatched to Great Yuan with condolences.
麻斤出 is the full given name.
Wanyan Maqin, back from abroad, was spared execution for failing his mission but removed from office.
Wanyan Majinchu was spared execution for failing his mission but removed from office.
出 is part of his name, not "back from abroad".
In the twelfth month an edict sent Vice Director Pu'a, Commander-in-Chief Hesheli Yawuta, and acting signatory Wanyan Eke to rescue Qingyang.
In the twelfth month an edict sent Vice Privy Commissioner Pu'a, Chief Commandant Heshilie Yawuta, and acting Privy Council signatory Wanyan Eke to rescue Qingyang.
副樞/總帥/權簽樞密院事 titles; 紇石烈 is Heshilie.
In the seventh year, spring, first month, Vice Director Pu'a, Commander-in-Chief Yawuta, and acting signatory Eke broke the Qingyang siege.
In the seventh year, spring, first month, Vice Privy Commissioner Pu'a, Commander-in-Chief Yawuta, and acting signatory Eke broke the Qingyang siege.
副樞 is vice commissioner of the Privy Council.
In winter, the tenth month, Participation Councillor Heda and Vice Director Pu'a marched to relieve Weizhou.
In winter, the tenth month, Grand Councillor Heda and Vice Privy Commissioner Pu'a marched to relieve Weizhou.
平章 is grand councillor; 副樞 is vice privy commissioner.
In autumn, the seventh month, Participation Councillor Heda became acting Privy Council vice director.
In autumn, the seventh month, Grand Councillor Heda became acting vice commissioner of the Privy Council.
平章政事 is grand councillor.
Weizhou was saved; the emperor went up Chengtian Gate to feast the troops; Heda and Pu'a each received hereditary meng'an.
Weizhou was saved; the emperor went up Chengtian Gate to feast the troops; Heda and Pu'a each received hereditary mouke.
世襲謀克 is a mouke, not meng’an.
Privy Council judge Bai Hua and Right Secretariat director Jiagu Balimen were sent to order the Wenxiang secretariat forward; Heda and Pu'a held back for lack of a chance.
Privy Council assistant commissioner Bai Hua and Right Office director Jiagu Balimen were sent to order the Wenxiang secretariat forward; Heda and Pu'a held back for lack of a chance.
樞密院判官 and 右司郎中 titles corrected.
Balizhuang in Song territory turned away its commander Naheda along with Heda and Pu'a.
The people of Balizhuang in Song territory rejected their own commander and admitted Heda and Pu'a.
納 means admitted; there is no person Naheda.
Heda and Pu'a were called to Bian to plan a march on Hezhong; afraid to proceed, they went back to Shaan Prefecture, sortied to Cold Water Valley, and returned.
Heda and Pu'a were called to Bian to plan a march on Hezhong; afraid to proceed, they went back to Shanzhou, sortied to Cold Water Valley, and returned.
Hezhong fell; acting signatory Caohuo Eke died in battle; Marshal Banzi Eke fled to Wenxiang with three thousand survivors.
Hezhong fell; acting Privy Council signatory Caohuo Eke died in battle; Marshal Banzi Eke fled to Wenxiang with three thousand survivors.
權簽樞密院事 is a Privy Council post.
On guimao the Department of State and Privy Council were set up inside the palace for quick access.
On guiwei the Department of State and Privy Council were set up inside the palace for quick access.
Wanyan Majin and others were ordered to raise ten thousand militia and breach the river to shield the capital.
Wanyan Majinchu and others were ordered to raise ten thousand militia and breach the river to shield the capital.
麻斤出 is the full given name.
On yiyou palace inspector Jiagu Sahe became supreme commander of thirty thousand infantry and cavalry to patrol the fords, with acting inner-service director Tushan Changle overseeing the force.
On yiyou palace inspector Jiagu Sahe became supreme commander of thirty thousand infantry and cavalry to patrol the fords, with acting inner-service director Tudan Changle overseeing the force.
Great Yuan forces closed on Zhengzhou, united with troops at Baipo, and camped; Marshal Ma Bojian surrendered the city and Defense Commissioner Ulinada Yaozhu was killed.
Great Yuan forces closed on Zhengzhou, united with troops at Baipo, and the garrison marshal Ma Bojian surrendered the city; Defense Commissioner Wulinda Yaozhu was killed.
屯軍元帥 is the garrison marshal; 烏林答 is Wulinda.
Privy Council vice director Pu'a was taken prisoner and soon died.
Privy Council vice commissioner Pu'a was taken prisoner and soon died.
樞密副使 is vice commissioner.
On gengzi the emperor proclaimed a general amnesty at the Du Gate and adopted the era name Kaixing.
On gengzi the emperor proclaimed a general amnesty at the Duan Gate and adopted the era name Kaixing.
端門 is the Duan Gate.
On gengxu Xuzhou troops mutinied, killed marshals Gulijia Shilun, Nihe Quanzhou, Su Chun, and others, and surrendered the city to Great Yuan.
On gengxu Xuzhou troops mutinied, killed marshals Gulijia Shilun, Nianhe Tongzhou, Su Chun, and others, and surrendered the city to Great Yuan.
粘合仝周 is romanized Nianhe Tongzhou.
On jiayin Great Yuan forces overran Linhuai; acting magistrate Zhang Ruoyu was killed.
On jiayin Great Yuan forces overran Linhuan; acting magistrate Zhang Ruoyu was killed.
Traveling secretariat Tushan Wudian and commander-in-chief Nahan Hehun were beaten and killed; Wanyan Zhongxi surrendered and was beheaded before the army.
Traveling secretariat Tudan Wudian and chief commandant Nahe Herun were beaten and killed; Wanyan Zhongxi surrendered and was beheaded before the army.
徒單 is Tudan; 納合合閏 is Nahe Herun.
On gengshen Hanlin academician awaiting appointment Feng Yandeng returned from the north.
On gengshen Hanlin edict attendant Feng Yandeng returned from the north.
翰林待制 is an edict attendant post.
On gengwu retired right grand councillor Saibu was recalled as left grand councillor.
On gengwu retired right chancellor Saibu was recalled as left chancellor.
右丞相/左丞相 are chancellors.
On jiawu an edict billeted Grand Councillor Bai Sa at the Upper Clarity Palace and Privy Council vice director Hexi at the Great Buddha Temple for emergencies.
On jiawu an edict billeted Grand Councillor Bai Sa at the Upper Clarity Palace and Privy Council vice commissioner Hexi at the Great Buddha Temple for emergencies.
樞密副使 is vice commissioner.
Duke of Mi Su said the Prince of Cao was young and offered to go instead; the emperor consoled him but would not accept the exchange.
Duke of Mi, Shu, said the Prince of Cao was young and offered to go instead; the emperor consoled him but would not accept the exchange.
密國公璹: the duke of Mi, named Shu.
Duke of Michi Jun Jun died.
密國公璹 is the Duke of Mi, Shu.
On renyin left vice director Li Xi escorted the Prince of Cao out as hostage; remonstrance officer Peiman Ahu Dai and grand storehouse superintendent Guo Shirong were peace envoys.
On renyin left vice director Li Xi escorted the Prince of Cao out as hostage; Grand Master of Remonstrance Peiman Ahudai and grand storehouse superintendent Guo Shirong were peace envoys.
諫議大夫 title; one-word given name.
Great Yuan forces assaulted Bian; the emperor went out the Gate of Heavenly Succession to hearten the western defenders.
Great Yuan forces assaulted Bian; the emperor went out Chengtian Gate to hearten the western defenders.
Keep 承天門 consistent with other units.
In summer, the fourth month, on guichou, soldier Li Xin was promoted to Four-Directions envoy for merit.
In summer, the fourth month, on guichou, soldier Li Xin was promoted to commissioner of the Hall of the Four Quarters for merit.
四方館使 heads the Hall of the Four Quarters.
On jiazi the emperor proclaimed a general amnesty at the Du Gate and adopted the era name Tianxing.
On jiazi the emperor proclaimed a general amnesty at the Duan Gate and adopted the era name Tianxing.
端門 is the Duan Gate.
The imprisoned families of the Prince of Hao Li and the Prince of Wei Shaowang were freed to go where they wished.
The imprisoned families of Prince Li of Hao and Prince Shao of Wei were freed to go where they wished.
厲 and 紹 are posthumous names, not given names.
In the fifth month, on xinsi, tens of thousands of displaced people asked to leave the city; Saibu and Baisha Bu refused.
In the fifth month, on xinsi, tens of thousands of displaced people asked to leave the city; Saibu and Bai Sa refused.
白撒不聽 = Bai Sa did not listen; 不 is not part of the name.
On bingxu he worshipped Heaven at Daqing Hall and ordered Baisha Bu to retire.
On bingxu he worshipped Heaven at Daqing Hall and ordered Bai Sa to retire.
On yimao Baisha Bu dug a canal east of his mansion.
On yimao Bai Sa dug a canal east of his mansion.
On yiyou the Prince of Nanyang's son Zisi was sent to run the Department at Deng Prefecture and call up reinforcements.
On yiyou Silie, son of the Prince of Nanyang, was sent to run the Department at Deng Prefecture and call up reinforcements.
On dingsi Feng Xian took Xuzhou; Toudan Yidu fled to Suzhou and set Zhang Xing over the traveling secretariat.
On dingsi Feng Xian took Xuzhou; Tudan Yidu fled to Suzhou and set Zhang Xing over the traveling secretariat.

On jiaxu Suzhou frontier chiliarchs Gao Lage and Li Xuan killed military commissioner Hesheli Ahu and his son and asked traveling secretariat chief Toudan Yidu to command; Yidu refused, marched west with his staff, met Great Yuan forces at Gu Shu, and was killed.

On jiaxu Suzhou frontier chiliarchs Gao Lage and Li Xuan killed military commissioner Heshilie Ahu and his son and asked traveling secretariat chief Tudan Yidu to command; Yidu refused, marched west with his staff, met Great Yuan forces at Gushu, and was killed.
紇石烈 is Heshilie; 徒單 is Tudan. 穀熟 is the town Gushu.
On jisi an edict posthumously made Defend-the-Foe Grand General Wanyan Chenheshang military commissioner of the Zhennan Army.
On jisi an edict posthumously made Defend-against-Insult General of the Household Wanyan Chen Heshang military commissioner of the Zhennan Army.
禦侮中郎將 is a general of the household.
A stele was raised at the Reward-Loyalty Temple.
A stele was raised at the Shrine for Commending Loyalty.
Acting vice grand councillor Yang Sitai was removed.
Acting participant in governance Yang Sitai was removed.
權參知政事 is acting participant in governance.
On guawei Right Vice Director of State Yanshan Shilu was dismissed.
On guiwei Right Vice Director of State Yanzhan Shilu was dismissed.
癸未 is guiwei; 顏盞 is Yanzhan.
Minister of Personnel Wanyan Nushen was made vice grand councillor.
Minister of Personnel Wanyan Nushen was made participant in governance.
參知政事 is participant in governance.
On yiyou the people of the capital openly vowed to kill Baisa; a secret edict sent guards to protect his home.
On yiyou the people of the capital openly vowed to kill Bai Sa; a secret edict sent guards to protect his home.
白撒 is Bai Sa, as elsewhere.
On bingxu soldiers tore down Baisa's suburban villa.
On bingxu soldiers tore down Bai Sa's suburban villa.

On wei Suzhou commander Zhong Sengnu, claiming Guo An'yong had submitted, sent Attendant Direct Regular Yin Shiying and others with an edict making An'yong Prince of Yan and acting minister over the Eastern Capital and other circuits, granted the surname Wanyan, and renamed him Yong'an.

On yiwei Suzhou commander Zhong Sengnu, claiming Guo Anyong had submitted, sent Close Attendant Vice Director Yin Shiying and others with an edict making Anyong Prince of Yan and acting minister over the Jingdong and other circuits, granted the surname Wanyan, and renamed him Yong'an.
乙未 is yiwei. 近侍直長 is the vice director of close attendants. 京東 is the Jingdong circuit.
On yisi Venus, Jupiter, Mars, and the moon met in Jiao and Yi.
On yisi Venus, Jupiter, Mars, and the moon met in the Zhen and Yi lodges.

On bingwu participation councillor Wanyan Silie, Duke of Hengshan Wu Xian, and Gongchang commander-in-chief Wanyan Huxiehu led the generals from Ruzhou in relief; Hexi was made privy councilor with ten thousand men to support them; left vice director Li Xi was told to urge the army forward, and they set out.

On bingwu participant in governance Wanyan Silie, Duke of Hengshan Wu Xian, and Gongchang commander-in-chief Wanyan Huxiehu led the generals from Ruzhou in relief; Hexi was made Privy Council commissioner with ten thousand men to support them; left vice director Li Xi was told to urge the army forward, and they set out.
參知政事 is participant in governance. 樞密使 is Privy Council commissioner.
